scope: Command outputs from the run, cropped: tmux session control and scratch-directory creation are omitted. Everything else is kept as printed.
method: Official install script run as a normal user in the official ubuntu:24.04 container on a GitHub-hosted runner. Actual interactive login shells driven with tmux; query snapshots from a separate process.
install_log: Note: /home/dev/.local/bin is not on your $PATH. zoxide will not work unless it is added to $PATH.
